svg.title: E08 GATEWAY POWERBENCH engineering architecture
svg.desc: The isolated state machine gates stimulus on controlled limits and separates wiring, sensing and DUT boundaries. Surrogate replay supports reproducibility without high-energy fault procedures or flight qualification claims.
